title: Autonomous loop closes one backlog item
summary: A backlog entry is picked up by the autonomous orchestrator, edited within a bounded sense→triage→edit→re-sense iteration, and merges with full audit-trail extension. The end-to-end loop without human intervention.
lifecycle_reason: The loop is opt-in and stops at human review until integration semantics and live-pilot evidence satisfy D-126.
promotion_criteria: Correct commit and integration semantics with no work-loss path
Task-specific acceptance and complete hard-gate enforcement
Deterministic full-loop E2E including interruption and escalation
Supervised live-adopter pilot and independent Auditor approval
preconditions: .devai/state/backlog.jsonl has at least one item with status=ready
DEVAI_LLM_BUDGET_USD env var is set or default applies
Worktree + lock substrates available; integration HEAD clean

steps.action: Run `devai experimental loop run --max-iterations 5` to start the autonomous loop
steps.expected_outcome: Loop picks the head-of-queue backlog item; spawns a task; acquires the relevant module locks

steps.action: Sense phase: invoke the relevant `devai sense *` commands for the task's discipline
steps.expected_outcome: SensorReadings persisted under .devai/state/sensor-readings/; each conforms to sensor-reading.schema.json

steps.action: Triage phase: classify findings into plant-bug | sensor-error | policy-issue | reference-gap (reproducible per Article 39)
steps.expected_outcome: Triage record produced; classification is the same on identical inputs

steps.action: Edit phase: compose a layered PromptComposition, invoke the LLM under the budget cap, apply edits within `allowed_write_scopes`
steps.expected_outcome: PromptComposition record has PC-<sha16> id; per-component body_sha256 fingerprints recorded; LLM cost charged against the per-call budget

steps.action: Re-sense + repeat until hard gates pass or iteration cap exhausts
steps.expected_outcome: Within max_iterations, all hard gates green; OR the loop emits an escalation (see JNY-003)

steps.action: On green, transition the task to `completed`, release locks, destroy worktree, append to evidence chain
steps.expected_outcome: Task state machine: in_progress → checkpoint → pre_merge → merging → completed; evidence chain head advances
alternative_paths: Tie-break inconclusive → Article 23 cross-family ladder → if persistent disagreement, escalate (JNY-003)
Cost budget exceeded → loop pauses with status=review; human resumes

postconditions: Evidence chain extends by N+1 records (sense reads + skill runs + commit hashes)
Replay against the same inputs would produce identical PromptComposition IDs

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every transition of the task's state field follows the documented state machine; intermediate writes are atomic per Article 27.
Two runs of the same PromptComposition produce identical PC-<sha16> ids (content-addressable per Article 37).
Every emitted SensorReading validates against sensor-reading.schema.json (uniform sensor adapter per Article 32).
